name: renewal-brief
title: Internal renewal decision brief
for_each: select id,reference from contracts where status in ('draft','active')

sections.title: Agreement
sections.note: Internal review only. This document does not renew, cancel or serve notice. Confirm terms against the signed agreement.

sections.title: Outstanding promises
sections.sql: select reference,title,owner,due_on from obligations where contract_id=$1 and status='open' order by due_on

sections.title: Evidence
sections.sql: select title,kind,location from evidence where contract_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Delivery evidence
sections.sql: select reference,title,owner,due_on,status,completed_on,completion_evidence from obligations where contract_id=$1 order by due_on

sections.title: History
sections.sql: select actor,action,note,created_at from activity where contract_id=$1 order by created_at

name: retention-review
title: Personal information retention review
for_each: select id,reference from contracts where contains_personal

sections.title: Purpose and review date
sections.note: Check lawful purpose, record-keeping duties and legal holds. This report never authorises destruction.

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select rule,finding from compliance_findings where id=$1
